name: Rod of Endless Rope
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10th; Slot -; Price 4,000 gp; Weight 4lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Crafted from dark ebony and stained until it is a most lustrous black, this rod is a sculpted, 18-inch-long baton. Close inspection (Perception DC 15) reveals three barely noticeable indentations in the middle third ofthe rod.

The three indentations are in fact buttons. Pressing any one of the rod’s buttons requires a move action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If used as a weapon it functions as a +1 light mace.

The rod has three functions, each of which can be employed at will. However, no two functions can be used at the same time. The three functions of the rod are as follows.

Rope: When you press the first button, rope begins to appear from one end of the rod at a rate of 60 feet per round. The rod can create 300 feet of rope in this way. Pressing the button again stops the rope from appearing. Pressing it a third time retracts the rope back, also at a rate of 60 feet per round. This rope has the same hardness and hit points as the rest of the rod.
Grappling Hook and Rope: When you press the second button, a leather wrist loop springs from one end of the rod and the other end extends three hooks, forming a grapnel. Pressing the button again launches one end of the rod (the end with the newly formed grappling hook) in the direction you aimed. A length of rope up to 300 feet trails behind the launched grappling hook, this rope connects the end you are holding to the grappling hook; all 300 feet of rope can discharge in a single round. The rope stops extending if the hook strikes something solid (including a creature), and secures itself in place automatically if it strikes a solid non living object capable of bearing your weight.Pressing the button once more retracts the rope, drawing the held end toward the hooked end if it is secured properly. The retracting feature can pull up to 1,000 pounds, drawing 60 feet of rope per round. The rope has the same hardness and hit points as the rest of the rod. You may also use this to push back opponents within 30 feet (outside this distance the rod lacks sufficient power). On a successful ranged attack the hooked end deals 2d6 points of damage. The force of this is surprisingly strong, and those struck are subject to a bull rush combat maneuver. Treat the rod’s strength score as 20 for the check but otherwise calculate your combat maneuver bonus normally, including any feats or special abilities you possess which would add to the attack.

Grappling Hooks and Slide: The final button launches a second grappling hook from the opposite end of the rod using all the rules described above. When both grappling hooks are secured the middle section of the rod can be activated to expand slightly and slide back and forth across the rope you created at a speed of 40 ft. per round. This allows each end of the rod to create 300 feet of rope effectively giving you 600 feet of rope. The grappling hooks and rope can support no more than 1000 pounds.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, animate rope
